title: GridSim v1 shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the v1 case-file schemas (schemas/v1). This file holds $defs only. The v1 case format is the folder of JSON files read by src/GridSim.Core/IO/Json/JsonGridLoader.cs; these schemas describe exactly the members of its DTOs (JsonDtos.cs, AssetClassDto.cs, ProtectionDto.cs), pinned by a reflection drift test. Defaults for absent members are NOT stated with the 'default' keyword (the v2 validator's subset refuses it); they are the DTO defaults, read by reflection.

busId.title: Bus id
busId.description: A bus number as in buses.json: a whole number in the 32-bit range (the loader's DTO field is a C# int).
